name: edge-metals-loads
description: Edge Yard — standalone mobile app (Capacitor wrapper around the Loads tab's web code, talking to the same Jarvis backend as the dashboard).

scripts._comment_build: ALWAYS SYNC FIRST. 2026-10-05: the client-side network diagnostics built on 10-03 lived in www/ and were never in android/app/src/main/assets/public/, because this script went straight to gradle. The APK on her phone therefore could not report anything, /api/client-errors stayed empty, and we spent two days with no evidence for a bug we had already built the instrument for. cap sync is what copies www into the android project; a build script that skips it ships whatever happens to be sitting there.
scripts.build:android: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:release: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
